kilauea_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY DAILY UPDATE
kilauea_notices.message: HVO Kilauea ORANGE/WATCH - Small overflows from the north vent continue, along with tiny overflows from the south vent starting overnight. All vents have strong glow and intermittent spatter. There is no anomalous activity outside of the summit.

mauna_loa_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY MONTHLY UPDATE
mauna_loa_notices.message: HVO Haleakala GREEN/NORMAL - No activity of concern for Haleakalā.
